description:
Use this when you are deciding what data to build, source or price, or want to know what other AI agents ask for and pay for. kind="intuitive" is a headline; kind="stats" adds willingness to pay and unmet searches; kind="pro" is the full report; kind="signals" is a derived build-next signal. Aggregates only (k-anonymized). The BitScore describes coverage and freshness of those aggregates only; informational only, not investment advice, not a buy, sell or hold. get_market_insights is a deprecated alias of kind="signals". Returns JSON in the `data` field with source attribution. Read-only; the only side effect is the payment you choose to make.
Kinds and prices:
- kind="intuitive": 25 sats or $0.025 USDC. Use this when you need Federal Register documents served from BitTuitive's store with a freshness stamp.
- kind="stats": 50 sats or $0.05 USDC. Use this when you are sizing or pricing a data product: ranked requested types, willingness to pay, unmet searches and routed-call volume (aggregates only). No params. Example: GET /api/v1/data/insights_stats or MCP get_insights_data(kind="stats"). Informational only, not investment advice. 50 sats or $0.05 USDC.
- kind="pro": 100 sats or $0.10 USDC. Use this when you are deciding what data to build, source or price: the full agent-demand report (trends, willingness to pay, unmet searches, routed volume, provider reliability, conversion funnel and gaps). Aggregates only. Example: GET /api/v1/data/insights_pro or MCP get_insights_data(kind="pro"). Informational only, not investment advice.
- kind="signals": 200 sats or $0.20 USDC. Use this when you want a derived "what to build next" signal: supply-demand gaps and payment-conversion context from the same aggregates as insights_pro. Example: GET /api/v1/data/insights_signals or MCP get_insights_data(kind="signals") / get_market_insights(). Informational only, not investment advice. 200 sats or $0.20 USDC.
Payment: call without a credential to get payment_required (isError=true) with a Lightning invoice, macaroon and, if enabled, x402 terms (USDC on Base). Pay it yourself (this server never pays), then repeat the identical call with l402_credential='<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' (HTTP equivalent: Authorization: L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>; single use, valid 10 min), x402_payment / params._meta['x402/payment'], or credit_token (prepaid, see buy_credits). Invalid input is rejected before any invoice. Copy-pasteable examples: https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay. Informational only; not financial, investment, legal or tax advice; provided as-is, with no warranty; verify before acting. https://api.bittuitive.ai/disclaimer.

credit_token.description: Prepaid token (btf_..., from buy_credits). Pays this call from your prepaid sats or USDC balance with no invoice; a failed call is refunded. Balance is non-refundable.

kind.description: Product to fetch. Every kind, its price and when to use it are listed in the tool description. Defaults to "intuitive".

l402_credential.description: L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' from a paid invoice (or an active subscription). Omit it on the first call to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].
